title: Maximal Rectangle
summary: Find the area of the largest rectangle made only of 1s inside a grid of 0s and 1s.

tests.explain: The best rectangle is the 2 x 3 block of 1s in rows 1 and 2, columns 2 to 4: area 6.
A single 1 is a rectangle of area 1.

hints: Fix the bottom edge of the rectangle at row i. Then a rectangle is determined by a left column, a right column and how far up the 1s go.
For each row, build heights[j] = how many consecutive 1s end at row i in column j (reset to 0 on a 0). Each row then looks like a histogram.
The best rectangle with its bottom on row i is the largest rectangle in that histogram. Solve the histogram with a monotonic stack in O(columns), so the total is O(rows * columns).

complexity.time: O(rows * columns): one histogram pass per row
complexity.space: O(columns) for the heights and the stack
